description: Enterprise-grade access to OpenAI models through Azure infrastructure with additional security and compliance features

justification.D_rationale: D=1: Data processed on Azure infrastructure. Microsoft does not use customer data for model training. BAA available. Data stays within selected Azure region.
justification.T_rationale: T=1: Same model opacity as OpenAI API. Azure adds content filtering and abuse monitoring layers that are partially configurable.
justification.A_rationale: A=1: Models respond to API calls. Azure AI Assistants API adds some orchestration but individual model endpoints are invoked, not autonomous.

edge_case_notes: Azure AI Assistants with code interpreter and function calling may warrant Tier C classification when deployed as autonomous agents. Azure AI Agent Service explicitly targets Tier C use cases.
